resources.string: Send copies to my computers automatically
Whatever you copy while AirBridge runs in the background goes to your computers. Passwords and other text marked sensitive are never sent automatically.
Automatic copy sync needs \'Display over other apps\'

If a copy can\'t be sent automatically, the bubble shows a dot. Tap it to send. Some phones only let AirBridge notice copies while the optional \'Typing & clipboard\' service is on. If automatic sync does not work, allow \'Display pop-ups while running in the background\' for AirBridge in your phone\'s app permissions.
